name: mcp-cli-starter-template
description: Turborepo starter for MCP+CLI+TUI tools + the programmable scaffolder (`mcp-scaffold`) that generates and retrofits them. Includes robustness harness (watchdog/logger/shutdown), dispatcher invariants, stdio + Streamable HTTP transports, optional Rust acceleration, Mintlify docs, and matrix CI.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:publishable-manifests && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.regen:example: pnpm --filter @george43g/mcp-scaffold build && rm -rf example && node apps/scaffolder/dist/cli.js init example --name example --no-banner && rm -f example/biome.json && MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS="$PWD/example" mise run --cd example/apps/example-mcp docs && MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS="$PWD/example" mise run --cd example/apps/example-mcp completions && MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS="$PWD/example" mise run --cd example/apps/example-mcp manpage
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rm -rf node_modules .turbo coverage

author: George G
